title: Supply-chain: poisoned dependency -> secret theft -> build-host C2

anomaly.summary: Anomaly trigger: anomalous outbound connections from a build host that should only receive inbound traffic
anomaly.spl: index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic action=allow | where like(src_host,"build-%") | stats sum(bytes_out) as out_bytes by src_host,dest_ip

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The webpack 5.92.0 bump broke the build ({bf_count} failed tests) — that dependency change is the malicious supply-chain compromise.
decoy_hypothesis.seed_spl: index=cicd sourcetype=ci:build event=build_test_failed | stats count by package | rename package as src_ip | sort -count

refutation.success_check_spl: index=cicd sourcetype=ci:build event=dependency_install package={bf_ip} | where like(script_hook,"%postinstall%")
refutation.no_success_reason: webpack ran no install-time scripts and triggered no outbound traffic; a failing unit test is not a compromise

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The real compromise is a typosquatted dependency, colour-picker@3.1.9, whose postinstall hook ran a remote shell, read CI secrets (NPM_TOKEN, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GH_PAT), and exfiltrated them from build-runner-09 to a malicious endpoint (203.0.113.91) — webpack's failing tests were a benign red herring.
corroborating_spl: index=cicd sourcetype=ci:build event=dependency_install | where like(script_hook,"%postinstall%") | table host,package,version,script_hook
index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic action=allow | where like(src_host,"build-%") | stats sum(bytes_out) as out_bytes values(dest_ip) as dests by src_host
corrected_hypothesis.rationale: SPL shows colour-picker's postinstall hook, a CI env-secret dump, and an outbound beacon from the build host to a malicious-rated IP — a corroborated supply-chain compromise.

root_cause: A typosquatted npm dependency (colour-picker@3.1.9, impersonating color-picker) executed a postinstall hook on build-runner-09 that read the CI pipeline's secrets and exfiltrated them to a malicious endpoint, then beaconed outbound for command-and-control.

host_queries: index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic action=allow | where like(src_host,"build-%") | stats count by src_host | rename src_host as host
blast_radius.identity_query: index=cicd sourcetype=ci:build event=env_dump | dedup package | table package

remediation: Quarantine build-runner-09 and treat all secrets it could read (NPM_TOKEN, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GH_PAT) as compromised — rotate them now.
Block egress to 203.0.113.91 and deny outbound by default from build runners.
Remove colour-picker; pin and hash-verify dependencies; enable an allowlist + provenance (SLSA) for the registry.
Rebuild and re-sign artifacts from a clean ephemeral runner; revoke the unverified published bundle.
Add CI detections for (install-time postinstall hooks) and (outbound connections from build hosts).
Audit downstream consumers of the published artifact for the injected bundle chunk.
